data.name: Dihydromyricetin
data.description: Flavonoid from Ampelopsis grossedentata reported to reduce fibrosis with accompanying suppression of PI3K/AKT/mTOR signalling.
data.description_beginner: A flavonoid from vine tea. In animal studies it reduces fibrosis - the stiff scarring that replaces healthy tissue - and this comes together with a quieting of PI3K/AKT/mTOR signalling.
